name: Orcjection!
source:
Uryak Uda'wal (ATTORNEY AT LAW™) is the first orcish lawyer in history, and he's ready to make a splash! For his first case, he's facing impossible odds...can he prove his client innocent? Or will Ms. Paine be facing life behind bars for murder?! Find out by playing ORCJECTION!

[From [url=https://shinypaperclips.itch.io/orcjection]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
乌里亚克·乌达瓦尔（律师™）是历史上第一位兽人律师，他已经准备好大放异彩！对于他的第一个案件，他面临着不可能的胜算……他能证明他的客户是无辜的吗？或者潘恩女士会因谋杀而面临终身监禁吗？！通过玩“ORCJECTION”来找出答案！

[来自[url=https://shinypaperclips.itch.io/orcjection]itch.io[/url]]
